long_biography.plain_text:
Long Island Pipe Supply combined wholesaling with the workshop disciplines of pipe fabrication. Robert Moss founded the Garden City business in 1975 and developed it around fire-sprinkler systems, valves and fittings. Its facilities cut, grooved, threaded, drilled and welded pipe for contractors, while proprietary product lines and specialised machinery supported customers beyond the New York market.

Moss argued that local processing could offset the freight economics of imported pipe, making inventory depth and rapid customisation central to the company's model. After more than four decades of expansion, he agreed to sell the business to Core & Main in 2019. The buyer retained Long Island Pipe's branch network, fabrication capabilities and workforce as it integrated the business into its fire-protection division.
